## Overview
### Introduction to OpenAI o3
The OpenAI o3 model, released on 2025-04-16, is a premium, non-open-source language model provided by OpenAI. This model boasts an impressive set of capabilities, including text and vision processing, function calling, structured outputs, streaming, batch processing, and extended thinking. With a context window of 200,000 tokens and a maximum output of 100,000 tokens, o3 is well-suited for complex tasks that require in-depth analysis and reasoning.

### Technical Strengths and Use Cases
OpenAI o3 demonstrates exceptional performance across various benchmarks, including MMLU (94.2), HumanEval (96.7), LMSYS Arena ELO (1390), and GSM8K (99.7). Its strengths make it an ideal choice for applications involving complex reasoning, math, science, coding, research, and PhD-level problems, as well as legal analysis and financial modeling. However, it is not recommended for simple tasks, high-volume requests, low-latency applications, or budget-conscious projects. The pricing structure for o3 includes $2.0 per 1M input tokens, $8.0 per 1M output tokens, $1.0 per 1M cached input tokens, and $1.0 per 1M batch input tokens.
